instructions.content: Generate or convert projects to Bun executors.
Configure cache inputs and outputs for build and test targets.

Validate serve, build and test on one project and confirm all three exit with code 0 before proceeding; on failure check executor configuration in project.json, run nx reset and retry, and resolve all failures before rolling out.
Roll out to affected projects and enforce anti-pattern checks.
NEVER mix npm/yarn installs with Bun in the same migration scope.
NEVER run Jest and bun test on the same suite without a boundary.
NEVER skip cache metadata on Bun build/test targets.
NEVER assume SQLite behaviour is identical to Node DB wrappers.
NEVER rely on hot reload defaults for production validation.
Bun.spawn is async and returns a handle; choose stdout/stderr piping explicitly.
Remove obsolete lockfiles as part of a controlled cutover.
Use nx reset after plugin updates because the Nx daemon and cache can mask executor changes.
Run affected projects in CI with bun nx affected -t lint,test,build --base=main --parallel=3.
Use the @nx-bun/nx build, run and test executors for the Bun targets.
